how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-silverpine-forest-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:99:obj:0: Bring 6 Pyrewood Shackles to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.
rows.quest:99:details:0: As my understanding of Arugal's magic grows so does my disdain for the hapless fool. I am close to completing my research on his so called remedy.
rows.quest:99:details:1: BMy knowledge will be complete when I learn what enchantment is causing the strange behavior going on in Pyrewood Village. By day, the peasants appear to be Human. But when the sun goes down the townsfolk turn into Moonrage Worgen.
rows.quest:99:details:2: BI need to draw energy from the enchanted shackles Arugal cast on them. Bring to me six enchanted Pyrewood Shackles, ⟦1⟧.
rows.quest:99:completion:0: Your persistence is commendable. With the knowledge you helped me gather, Arugal will fall and his reckless magic shall be undone. Cheers to you, ⟦2⟧.
rows.quest:421:obj:0: Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher wants you to kill 5 Moonrage Whitescalps.
rows.quest:421:details:0: Lady Sylvanas has charged Varimathras with the conquering of the human and dwarven lands to the south.
rows.quest:421:details:1: BBut that fool, Arugal -- charlatan of ⟦E1⟧ and now cursed beast of Shadowfang Keep -- let his reckless magic wreak havoc with the strategic stronghold of ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:421:details:2: BI need someone skilled in the ways of combat to help clean up Arugal's mess. Prove yourself to me by killing 5 Moonrage Whitescalps. The wretched beasts can often be found just off the road, down the hill below.
rows.quest:421:completion:0: You have served me well, ⟦3⟧. It is obvious to me that you will be a worthy aide to me as I prepare to rid ⟦E2⟧ of Arugal's curse.
rows.quest:422:obj:0: Retrieve the Remedy of Arugal for Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.
rows.quest:422:details:0: How Arugal gained acceptance within the Kirin ⟦E3⟧ is beyond me. His spell-casting knowledge seemed as transparent as a blown glass bauble.
rows.quest:422:details:1: BWhat's important now is learning exactly what magic Arugal used so that I can turn it against him and secure ⟦E2⟧ for the Dark Lady.
rows.quest:422:details:2: BArugal first stayed at the wheat farm just north of the bridge. One of the Deathstalkers reported seeing some spellbooks but could not secure them. Retrieve for me the spell labeled Remedy of Arugal from those books.
rows.quest:422:completion:0: This is precisely the spell I was in search of, ⟦4⟧. If your dedication to The Dark Lady's cause remains infallible you will find you have quite a future amongst The ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:423:obj:0: Bring 6 Glutton Shackles and 3 Darksoul Shackles to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.
rows.quest:423:details:0: After examining Arugal's work my worst suspicions were confirmed. The old hack was not qualified to clean chamber pots in ⟦E1⟧ let alone represent the Kirin ⟦E3⟧ in its most dire hour. Fools!
rows.quest:423:details:1: BArugal used enchanted items to reinforce his weak magic. I need to examine these items first hand. ⟦E5⟧ forth and slay Moonrage Gluttons and Moonrage Darksouls until you have collected enough of their enchanted shackles for my research. The foul creatures have been seen to the north and east.
rows.quest:423:completion:0: I hope I can acquire enough energy from such a limited sample. Perhaps I should have had you get more shackles.
rows.quest:423:completion:1: BNonetheless, you showed great skill in collecting these, ⟦5⟧.
rows.quest:424:obj:0: Kill Grimson the Pale and bring his head to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.
rows.quest:424:details:0: It will indeed take me longer than I had thought to uncover the dark secrets behind the enchantments Arugal was using.
rows.quest:424:details:1: BBut in the meantime I need you to take care of a slight problem our Darkstalkers have discovered. It seems that Arugal let his magic spread to the Deep Elem Mine in the hills to the southeast.
rows.quest:424:details:2: BThe mine would prove to be quite a resource for Varimathras's advance.
rows.quest:424:details:3: BI want you to behead the tainted foreman of the mine, Grimson the Pale. With his death, the mine shall be ours.
rows.quest:424:completion:0: Most excellent. The mine will provide superb resources for our forces as we spread throughout Silverpine and into ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:425:obj:0: Kill Ivar the Foul, and bring Ivar's Head to Rane Yorick at the Ivar Patch.
rows.quest:425:details:0: My brother Quinn and I were tasked to recon ⟦E2⟧ and report to High Executor Hadrec. But we didn't get far -- when moving through this farm we were attacked by the ghoul Ivar the Foul.
rows.quest:425:details:1: BWe escaped from Ivar, but he seriously mauled Quinn. He's healing from the potion you gave him, but Ivar may return before Quinn recovers.
rows.quest:425:details:2: BKill Ivar so Quinn will have time to heal. Ivar is usually in the barn yonder, waiting for my guard to drop.
rows.quest:425:completion:0: Ah, thank you. You have my gratitude, ⟦6⟧.
rows.quest:425:completion:1: BAnd I will include you in the report I make to my superiors.
rows.quest:428:obj:0: Find the Deathstalkers Quinn and Rane Yorick.
rows.quest:428:details:0: A couple weeks ago two of our Deathstalkers, Rane and Quinn Yorick, were sent on a reconnaissance mission through northern Silverpine. We have not heard from them.
rows.quest:428:details:1: BThey may have become victim to the Scourge, though if that is true then I want it confirmed. Find these Deathstalkers.
rows.quest:428:details:2: BTheir first objective was to scout the farms in northern Silverpine. You should begin your search there.
rows.quest:428:completion:0: You found us! And not a moment too soon...
rows.quest:429:obj:0: Gather 6 discolored worg hearts and bring them to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.
rows.quest:429:details:0: My brother Quinn was badly hurt by the ghoul, Ivar the Foul, and I don't know if he will heal properly without magical aid. Although I am not an apothecary, I do know that our apothecaries can make healing potions from the discolored hearts of worgs.
rows.quest:429:details:1: BGather such hearts and take them to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher to the south. Then return here with the potion.
rows.quest:429:details:2: BYou can find plenty of worgs between here and Malden's Orchard to the east.
rows.quest:429:completion:1: BIt is troubling to hear our Deathstalkers have failed their mission.
rows.quest:429:completion:2: BLet us hope that these failures are rare.
rows.quest:429:completion:3: BI'll give you the potion in a moment, but here is its recipe - if those Deathstalkers find themselves in need of future aid, then perhaps you can give it yourself.
rows.quest:430:obj:0: Bring Quinn's potion to Quinn Yorick at the Ivar Patch, north of the Sepulcher.
rows.quest:430:details:0: Here is the potion to aid in Quinn Yorick's recovery.
rows.quest:430:details:1: BNow if you will excuse me, I have very important work to continue...
rows.quest:430:completion:0: <Quinn takes the potion and drinks it>
rows.quest:430:completion:1: BYes, I can feel it working. I will soon be able to travel.
rows.quest:430:completion:2: BYou have done me a great favor, ⟦8⟧.
rows.quest:435:obj:0: Escort Erland through the wolves, to Rane Yorick.
rows.quest:435:details:0: The wolves outside won't leave, and they eye me evilly every time I step foot out that door. They must be incredibly hungry to think I'm worth eating.
rows.quest:435:details:1: BI have to report to my teammate, the Deathstalker Rane Yorick. And to get to Rane, I'll need help against those wolves.
rows.quest:435:details:2: BPlease escort me! And there are a lot of wolves out there, so we'll have a better chance if you have friends who can help...
rows.quest:435:completion:0: Thank you for the aid, ⟦9⟧. I had feared Erland was overcome by the dangers of Silverpine. With your help, I see that he has not.
rows.quest:437:obj:0: Kill rot hide gnolls at the Dead Fields.
rows.quest:437:obj:2: BBring the Essence of Nightlash to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.
rows.quest:437:details:0: Our initial scouting reports of Silverpine show the rot hides have a base at an old farm to the north, the Dead Fields. We have sent small assaults against them, but each time they are reinforced by the banshee Nightlash, who uses her magic to rout our forces.
rows.quest:437:details:2: BGo to the Dead Fields and assault the rot hides. If you don't see Nightlash then kill the rot hides until she appears, then defeat her.
rows.quest:437:details:3: BHer essence will turn to dust. Bring me that dust as proof.
rows.quest:437:completion:0: I heard of your successful raid against the rot hides, ⟦10⟧, and this essence is proof of Nightlash's death.
rows.quest:437:completion:1: BThe Scourge have lost ground this day. Your value to the ⟦E4⟧ grows.
rows.quest:438:obj:1: BSearch for the reason the Scourge are there.
rows.quest:438:details:0: ⟦11⟧, we've discovered a new hive for the Scourge: the Decrepit Ferry. The ferry lies east of the Sepulcher, and is heavily patrolled by rot hides and other undead.
rows.quest:438:details:1: BThere must be a reason for the Scourge's occupation of the area. Go to the Decrepit Ferry and find out why the Scourge are there.
rows.quest:438:completion:0: Heaped within this boat is a pile of wrapped corpses. And looking east across Lordamere Lake, an opposing dock on Fenris Isle can be seen.
rows.quest:438:completion:1: BThe fate of the corpses must lie on Fenris Isle.
rows.quest:439:obj:0: Bring Deliah's Ring to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.
rows.quest:439:details:0: Among the corpses a hand protrudes, unwrapped. It is the hand of a woman, pockmarked from the plague but relatively fresh.
rows.quest:439:details:1: BOn the hand is a ring. Removing the ring and inspecting it reveals an engraving:
rows.quest:439:completion:0: You say that this ring was worn by a woman, recently killed?
rows.quest:439:completion:1: BThe only nearby source of such a body would be the mass graves in Tirisfal. The Rot Hide Gnolls must be taking those corpses to Fenris Isle!
rows.quest:440:obj:0: Bring Deliah's Ring to Magistrate Sevren in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:440:details:0: If you want to find the husband or beloved who gave Deliah her ring... then speak with Magistrate Sevren in ⟦E7⟧. He should have records of recent deaths and, with luck, can discover who Deliah is.
rows.quest:440:details:1: BBut I wouldn't hope. Whoever gave her the ring is probably dead. Or if he's undead he probably no longer cares about Deliah.
rows.quest:440:completion:0: A Deliah did live in ⟦E7⟧ not long ago. She was buried in the mass grave but if what you say is true, then the Rot Hide Gnolls must have stolen her body and taken it to Silverpine.
rows.quest:440:completion:1: BThe Rot Hides, like all the Scourge, must be destroyed. I trust you are taking steps to make that happen.
rows.quest:441:details:0: Deliah had a husband, Raleigh, who now dwells in the ⟦E8⟧. If the Deliah who lived in ⟦E7⟧ is the one who owned this ring, then Raleigh will know.
rows.quest:441:details:1: BRaleigh is in the Trade Quarter of the ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:441:completion:0: Yes, this ring was my wife's. Her fate was the fate of all who fail to endure these harsh times. I feel nothing for her death, nor for the story you tell of her body's abduction.
rows.quest:441:completion:1: BSuch feelings have long since grown cold within me. But desire does still burn in my dead heart, ⟦12⟧.
rows.quest:442:obj:0: Bring Thule's Head to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.
rows.quest:442:details:0: Now is the time to assault the Scourge's place of strength in Silverpine: Fenris Isle.
rows.quest:442:details:1: BYou must again go to the Isle and destroy Thule Ravenclaw. I want his head!
rows.quest:442:details:2: BThis mission is as dangerous as it is vital, ⟦13⟧. You must not fail.
rows.quest:442:completion:0: The death of Thule Ravenclaw was no small event, ⟦14⟧. Renferrel tells me that the energies released when you destroyed Thule were felt even as far as the Sepulcher.
rows.quest:442:completion:1: BYour actions ring through the ranks of the ⟦E4⟧. Your value to us grows.
rows.quest:443:obj:0: Bring 8 bottles of rot hide ichor to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.
rows.quest:443:details:0: Before we launch an assault on Fenris Isle, we must determine who is behind the rot hide gnolls. Our apothecaries believe their origin lies within the strange fluid that flows through their bodies.
rows.quest:443:details:1: BGo to Fenris Isle, east of the Decrepit Ferry, and collect rot hide ichor from the gnolls you find there. Bring it to Apothecary Renferrel, stationed outside the Sepulcher.
rows.quest:443:completion:0: Very good. This ichor will help us understand the nature of the rot hides, and may show us their weakness...
rows.quest:444:obj:0: Bring the Sample Ichor to Bethor Iceshard in the ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:444:details:0: I have reduced the ichor you brought me and separated it into its base components. My findings are not conclusive, but I have determined that warlock and necromantic magics were used in the ichor's creation.
rows.quest:444:details:1: BWhile I continue to study the ichor, I want you to take a sample to Bethor Iceshard in the ⟦E8⟧. Bethor is not an apothecary, but his knowledge of magic may help to unravel the mystery of the rot hides.
rows.quest:444:details:2: BGo. You will find Bethor in the Magic Quarter of the ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:444:completion:0: This substance is laced with powerful spells, some of which I have not seen for a long, long time...
rows.quest:444:completion:1: BOne moment -- I must invoke a spell of divination...
rows.quest:446:obj:0: Bring Bethor's Scroll to Apothecary Renferrel at the Silverpine Sepulcher.
rows.quest:446:details:0: This Ichor was crafted by an old colleague of mine: Thule Ravenclaw. He was a young, promising mage before the great war, but when the Lich King rose to power, he betrayed his brethren and allied with the Scourge.
rows.quest:446:details:1: BI did not realize he still lives, nor that he leads the Rot Hides in their forays against us!
rows.quest:446:details:2: BI know many of his spells, and can help concoct a potion to counter them. Take this scroll back to Apothecary Renferrel. It has the incantations needed for the potion.
rows.quest:446:completion:0: This scroll is laced with powerful magic. I've never used such forces in a potion ... it will be a powerful mixture, and should serve you well should you attack Thule in his stronghold on Fenris Isle.
rows.quest:447:obj:0: Collect 6 Grizzled Bear Hearts and 6 samples of Skittering Blood and deliver them to Master Apothecary Faranell in the ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:447:details:0: ⟦E9⟧'s numbers are overwhelming. But with a New Plague we could eradicate both the Scourge Army and the Human infestation once and for all.
rows.quest:447:details:1: BMy studies have proven that spider blood combined with a toxin derived from a grizzled bear heart results in a deadly elixir. Collect samples from the spiders in the Skittering Dark to the northwest and from the bears wandering throughout ⟦E2⟧. Deliver the reagents to Master Apothecary Faranell of the Royal Apothecary Society in the ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:447:completion:0: How good of Apothecary Renferrel to send you to me, ⟦15⟧. These samples will indeed prove useful to the cause. I will begin studying their toxic and contaminable properties at once.
rows.quest:448:obj:0: Report to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.
rows.quest:448:details:0: Before you launch an assault on Fenris Isle, report to High Executor Hadrec. He may have additional information or equipment you'll need.
rows.quest:448:completion:0: If what Bethor says is true then Thule Ravenclaw is a force that must be dealt with, and dealt with soon.
rows.quest:448:completion:1: BTo aid in this task, you may take something from our arsenal here...
rows.quest:449:obj:0: Bring the Deathstalker Report to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.
rows.quest:449:details:0: Although Quinn's wounds are mending, I want to get our report to High Executor Hadrec as quickly as possible. It has information that is vital to the ⟦E4⟧'s occupation of Silverpine.
rows.quest:449:completion:0: I hadn't accounted for the level of Scourge presence we've seen in ⟦E2⟧, nor for the troubles our Deathstalkers have had in their scouting efforts.
rows.quest:449:completion:1: BYour aid to our Deathstalkers was invaluable, ⟦16⟧. And you will be commended.
rows.quest:450:obj:0: Retrieve Apothecary Berard's journal from Pyrewood Village and take it to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.
rows.quest:450:details:0: You can be of further service to the Royal Apothecary Society, ⟦17⟧.
rows.quest:450:details:1: BWhen Arugal cast his wretched magic on the forest, he cursed one of our most promising members, Apothecary Berard. Now a mindless servant of Arugal, Berard is useless to us. But his findings might prove to be of worth. He was studying an ancient plague that killed off all the aquatic life in Lake Lordamere ages ago.
rows.quest:450:details:2: BRetrieve Berard's Journal from his study in the Pyrewood Village Inn and take it to Apothecary Renferrel.
rows.quest:450:completion:0: Apothecary Berard's journal! Why you are quite brave, ⟦18⟧. Now let's see what Berard was up to before he went mad. . .
rows.quest:451:obj:0: Bring 6 samples of Lake Creeper Moss, 6 samples of Lake Skulker Moss and a Hardened Tumor to Master Apothecary Faranell in the ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:451:details:0: According to Berard's Journal the moss from Lake Skulkers and Creepers might prove useful for our quest to brew a new plague. Those beasts dwell on the islands in Lake Lordamere to the east.
rows.quest:451:details:1: BHe also mentions a very rare Hardened Tumor that he discovered on a Vile Fin murloc. Apparently the tumor is so rare Berard was only able to obtain one.
rows.quest:451:details:2: BCollect samples of the moss as well as the rare hardened tumor and take them to Master Apothecary Faranell in the ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:451:completion:0: Such a blow to the Royal Apothecary Society to lose Berard. But through your hard work and Apothecary Renferrel's diligent research Berard's studies will still be useful to The Dark Lady's plight.
rows.quest:451:completion:1: BWe are on the cusp of something great here, ⟦19⟧. If you were not so skilled in the ways of combat I would try to recruit you for membership in the Society.
rows.quest:452:obj:0: Help Deathstalker Faerleia kill the Pyrewood Council.
rows.quest:452:details:0: You got here just in the nick of time, ⟦20⟧!
rows.quest:452:details:1: BThe Pyrewood Council will be returning any moment. Arugal has other matters to tend to in the keep. He uses the Council as mere puppets to keep the mindless minions of Pyrewood under his control. But I believe that without the guidance of the Pyrewood Council, the sons of Arugal will turn against their master.
rows.quest:452:details:2: BI cannot handle them all by myself. I need you to help me. Together we can lay waste to the Council for Lady Sylvanas.
rows.quest:452:completion:0: You fought like a true disciple of the Dark Lady, ⟦21⟧. With the council dead, perhaps we can gain control of this town once and for all and drive Arugal from Shadowfang Keep. I salute you!
rows.quest:460:obj:0: Bring Alaric's Head to his grave.
rows.quest:460:details:0: You don't look like a rot hide. Good. I had lost hope...
rows.quest:460:details:1: BMy name is Alaric, and I was once Thule's head servant and bodyguard. He used his magic to "protect" me from the Plague of Undeath, but instead his spell gave me an unlife from which I cannot escape. And after creating the cursed rot hide gnolls, Thule beheaded me... and gave my head to the gnolls as a plaything!
rows.quest:460:details:2: BPlease, take me to my body. I believe the gnolls buried it here in Fenris Keep, near the stable, in an unmarked grave.
rows.quest:460:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦22⟧. I had feared the Gnolls destroyed my body. It is good to know they did not.
rows.quest:461:obj:0: Take Alaric to the hidden alcove.
rows.quest:461:details:0: I know of a hidden niche within the keep that holds an item dear to Thule, and his old colleagues. It also holds something you might find useful. Take me there!
rows.quest:461:details:1: BThe alcove is in the southwestern tower of the keep, behind a dusty shelf.
rows.quest:461:details:2: BTake my body, but leave my boots. They never fit me anyway...
rows.quest:461:completion:0: There we are, it's open. Leave me here. I spent the best days of my life in this keep, and the thought of resting within its walls gives me comfort.
rows.quest:461:completion:1: BBe sure to close the alcove tight - I don't want those Rot Hides to find me.
rows.quest:461:completion:2: BOh, and take this. You've earned it.
rows.quest:477:obj:0: Retrieve the contents of one of the ⟦E1⟧ wizards' crates. You will find Pyrewood Village to the south.
rows.quest:477:details:0: As you may know, the town of Ambermill remains a source of human opposition, mainly through the support they receive from the wizards of ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:477:details:1: BI don't know what their plan is, but for them to show interest in a backwater village like Ambermill indicates that it must have some greater importance.
rows.quest:477:details:2: BThey've been shipping crates by the wagon from Hillsbrad. Many of those supplies end up at a small camp north of Pyrewood Village. Retrieve the contents of a crate and return them to me.
rows.quest:477:completion:0: <Prying open the lid of the crate, you find an assortment of carefully-packed objects. On the top of the crate lies a bundle of maps, yellowing with age, that appear to depict ⟦E2⟧ and other parts of western Lordaeron.
rows.quest:477:completion:1: BUnderneath the maps is a mysterious-looking magical pendant.>
rows.quest:478:obj:0: Bring the strange pendant to Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher.
rows.quest:478:details:0: <You quickly remove the pendant from the crate and replace the lid.>
rows.quest:478:completion:0: Maps and this... pendant, hm? Interesting.
rows.quest:478:completion:1: BIt is obvious that the ⟦E1⟧ wizards are interested in Ambermill for some purpose, but still, their aim is hidden to me.
rows.quest:478:completion:2: BPerhaps Dalar will know something of their use.
rows.quest:479:obj:0: Obtain 8 ⟦E1⟧ Pendants for Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher.
rows.quest:479:details:0: Dalar is attempting to locate the source of the wizards' spellcasting. For now, we'll have to slow their progress in any way we can...
rows.quest:479:details:1: BThe conjurers, mages and protectors are no doubt carrying the pendants. Remove and retrieve them.
rows.quest:479:details:2: BTake the main road south and the eastern fork into Ambermill.
rows.quest:479:completion:0: Dalar has found that the weaving is quite far along, despite the setback.
rows.quest:479:completion:1: BA wizard of great power is guiding the magic energy. He must be stopped quickly.
rows.quest:480:obj:0: Kill the ⟦E1⟧ archmage, then retrieve his staff for Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher.
rows.quest:480:details:0: An archmage of great power is overseeing the reactivation of the ley energy node. With the progress they have made, our only hope of stopping them is by killing him. It will be difficult, he is no doubt protected by many other mages and warders.
rows.quest:480:details:1: BYou must go, and you must dispatch him quickly. When he is dead, retrieve his staff for me. Go now.
rows.quest:480:completion:0: The magic of the wizards dissipates, and the ley energies fade into dormancy. Your efforts have been fruitful, ⟦23⟧, and we have dealt a major blow to our enemies, and to the overbearing wizards of ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:480:completion:1: BWe must be vigilant, however, knowing that source of energy lies so close at hand... Plans must be made for the future.
rows.quest:481:obj:0: Take the rune-inscribed pendant to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.
rows.quest:481:details:0: Take the pendant to Dalar Dawnweaver, perhaps he can shed some light on the wizards' plans.
rows.quest:481:completion:0: Interesting, more machinations of the Kirin ⟦E3⟧, it would seem. This is a powerful artifact. It was used frequently by powerful wizards of the Kirin ⟦E3⟧ to channel magical energies.
rows.quest:481:completion:1: BThat they are delivering so many to Ambermill indicates that they must be undergoing a project of some magnitude.
rows.quest:481:completion:2: BI will see if I can pierce their shields and ascertain their intent.
rows.quest:482:obj:0: Speak with Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher.
rows.quest:482:details:0: Of course! How could I have forgotten?
rows.quest:482:details:1: BAmbermill was one of the sites earmarked by the Kirin ⟦E3⟧, noted because it houses a dormant ley energy node. The wizards must be planning to reactivate the node and use its energies for some greater purpose.
rows.quest:482:details:2: BWe cannot allow this to happen...
rows.quest:482:details:3: BIt will take a great amount of power to activate the area's ley energies, we can stall them by taking the pendants away from the wizards.
rows.quest:482:details:4: BRelay this information to Allister, he will decide a course of action.
rows.quest:482:completion:0: Ill news you bring, ⟦24⟧. If Dalar is correct--and I've no reason to believe he isn't--we must move quickly.
rows.quest:482:completion:1: BI must confer with him on our plan of attack. But in the meanwhile we will have to delay their progress.
rows.quest:491:obj:0: Take the Woven Wand to Bethor Iceshard in the Magic Quarter of the ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:491:details:0: Thule once told me that, long ago, he and two colleagues created a magic wand, woven together from the apprentice wands each mage possessed. This wand was a symbol of their friendship, and although Thule came to despise it he could not part with it, nor could he let the others have it. So he stole the wand, and hid it in Fenris Keep.
rows.quest:491:details:1: BHere. Take the wand to Bethor Iceshard, one of Thule's friends from years past. I'm sure he will want it.
rows.quest:491:completion:0: ...what is this? Thule had our Woven Wand? I thought it was lost when our friendship sundered and he sided with the Lich King!
rows.quest:491:completion:1: BHe must not have invoked its power, for if he had I would have sensed it. And it is good that he did not use it...
rows.quest:491:completion:2: BThis is a marvelous find. You have my gratitude, ⟦25⟧, and will be rewarded.
rows.quest:493:obj:0: Deliver Apothecary Renferrel's findings to Apothecary Lydon in the town of Tarren Mill in the ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:493:details:0: The Royal Apothecary Society is under extreme pressure from the Dark Lady to develop a New Plague. We are working diligently and have made much progress. It is our belief that the success will be achieved much faster if we share information amongst the Society.
rows.quest:493:details:1: BFor that reason I want you to deliver my latest findings to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill, a small town nestled in the ⟦E10⟧. The journey will be a long one.
rows.quest:493:details:2: BHead south and stick to the roads. Follow the signs closely!
rows.quest:493:completion:0: Ah, most excellent. Apothecary Renferrel has my utmost respect. I am anxious to study his work.
rows.quest:516:obj:0: Locate Beren's Peril, then kill 6 Ravenclaw Drudgers and 6 Ravenclaw Guardians, then return to Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher.
rows.quest:516:details:0: I have received reports that a group of undead are holing up to prepare for an attack against us. Armed with this information, we can turn the tables and attack them first, nipping their little plan in the bud.
rows.quest:516:details:1: BUnfortunately, my information is spotty, at best. They are reported to be hiding in a location known as Beren's Peril. The exact location is unknown, but it appears to be a cave in the hills, near a pocket of ⟦E1⟧ wizards.
rows.quest:516:details:2: BI trust your resourcefulness. Find them, and put them down.
rows.quest:516:completion:0: If our scouts and agents continue to procure valuable information such as this, we shall have the Lich King's Scourge removed from our lands in no time.
rows.quest:530:obj:1: BBring his hands to Raleigh Andrean in the ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:530:details:0: Valdred, once my good friend, was my wife's murderer. Although I am incapable of grieving, I do yearn for revenge. If you kill Valdred and bring me his cursed hands, then I will reward you.
rows.quest:530:details:1: BI last heard he was at the Greymane Wall in southern Silverpine, trying to flee into the kingdom of Gilneas.
rows.quest:530:completion:0: Ah, good. These hands killed my wife, Deliah. ⟦E11⟧ for her murder was my only care, and you were the instrument of that revenge.
rows.quest:530:completion:1: BHere, take the ring you returned earlier. Deliah has been dead to me for so long, her ring is a bauble I no longer care to keep. Instead, I will keep these hands as a remembrance of my friend's betrayal.
rows.quest:3221:obj:0: Speak with Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.
rows.quest:3221:details:0: While you were out helping our deathstalkers, Apothecary Renferrel sent you a summons. He did not give me details, but he wanted to speak with you about the wolf hearts you had given him.
rows.quest:3221:completion:0: Ah, very good. There is a matter regarding the wolf hearts you brought to me earlier that demands our attention.
rows.quest:6321:obj:0: Bring Podrig's Order to Karos Razok.
rows.quest:6321:details:0: Executor Hadrec asked me to take stock of our equipment at the Sepulcher. With the Scourge, and worse, lurking in the woods, he doesn't want the Deathguards to lack gear they might need.
rows.quest:6321:details:1: BI found that we are, in general, well stocked, but we do need more weapons to replace those lost in the field.
rows.quest:6321:details:2: BHere is a requisition order of what is needed, for the weapon dealer Gordon Wendham in the ⟦E8⟧. Take the order to our bat master, Karos Razok, and speak with him about transport to the ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:6321:completion:0: Ah, an order for supplies. You will want to take this to the ⟦E8⟧, no doubt. And quickly, for the Sepulcher must not be left under stocked.
rows.quest:6322:obj:0: Bring Gordon's Crate to Michael Garrett.
rows.quest:6322:details:0: I have placed the Sepulcher's supplies into this crate. If you have already visited the Sepulcher and spoken with their bat master, then you may ride a bat back to him.
rows.quest:6322:details:1: BSpeak with the ⟦E8⟧'s bat master, Michael Garrett. He can provide you with a bat to the Sepulcher.
rows.quest:6322:completion:0: This crate must reach the Sepulcher in Silverpine? That is easily done; our bats fly there daily.
